findings.evidence: The file's own `IsOneLoopRGSolution.add_landauTime_notMem` (line 252) names the same `t₀ + landauTime β₀ (f t₀)` shape with the `add` prefix; the two are inconsistent.
findings.issue: `landauTime_oneLoopCoupling` states `s + landauTime β₀ (oneLoopCoupling β₀ a₀ s) = landauTime β₀ a₀`, but the name advertises the head `landauTime (oneLoopCoupling …)`; `rw [landauTime_oneLoopCoupling]` will not fire on that term, since the LHS is an `add`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib names set-restricted equalities `eqOn_…`: `IsOpen.eqOn_of_deriv_eq … : s.EqOn f g` (Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/MeanValue.lean:779), the very lemma used at line 228.
findings.fix: Rename to `IsOneLoopRGSolution.eqOn_oneLoopCoupling` and `IsOneLoopRGSolution.inv_eqOn` (optionally stating them with `Set.EqOn`, which the proofs already produce).
findings.issue: `IsOneLoopRGSolution.eq_oneLoopCoupling` proves only `∀ t ∈ Ioo A B, f t = oneLoopCoupling β₀ (f t₀) (t - t₀)`, i.e. a `Set.EqOn` on the interval with a shifted argument, while the name reads as the function equality `f = oneLoopCoupling …`. Same mismatch at line 216 for `IsOneLoopRGSolution.inv_eq`, whose equation also holds only on `Ioo A B`.

findings.evidence: Roadmap convention 1: "The evolution variable is `t = log (Q² / μ₀²)`" (CollinearEvolution/README.md:103); sibling API `IsDGLAPLogScaleEquation` and `dglapRhsLogScale` for "the logarithmic scale variable `τ = log Q2`" (Evolution/Basic.lean:18, 224, 285).
findings.fix: Rename `landauTime` to `landauLogScale` (keeping `landauScaleSq` for `Λ²`) and update the dependent lemma names accordingly.
findings.issue: `landauTime` coins "time" for the value of the evolution variable `t = log (Q²/μ₀²)` at the pole. The standard term is the Landau pole (as the file's own docstrings say), and the roadmap and the adjacent declarations in this directory call `t` the log-scale/evolution variable, not a time. This propagates to `landauTime_def`, `one_add_mul_landauTime_eq_zero`, `landauTime_neg`, `landauTime_lt_iff`, `tendsto_oneLoopCoupling_nhdsGT_landauTime`, `IsOneLoopRGSolution.add_landauTime_notMem` and `landauTime_oneLoopCoupling`.

summary: Most names describe their conclusions correctly, but three are off: a lemma whose name omits the leading `s +` of its LHS (so it cannot be used as a rewrite under its advertised head), a set-restricted equality named as an unrestricted one, and a coined `landauTime` for the evolution variable that the roadmap and the adjacent modules call the log-scale variable.
